description: Foundation: define the shared component set and tokens once, then migrate every shared component in src/components onto it. Nothing in src/pages changes except what must change to keep compiling (props kept backward compatible). Decisions: Button variants contained|outlined|soft|text x colors inherit|primary|secondary|info|success|warning|error (already match Minimal), sizes small 30px|medium 36px|large 48px (Minimal button.jsx). New startIcon/endIcon props; icon 18px, placed before the label. ButtonLink renders react-router Link/anchor with identical classes. IconButton: round (rounded-full), sizes small 30|medium 36|large 48, variants text|soft, hover bg-grey-500/8, required aria-label.
steps: Add src/components/ui/Button/buttonClasses.ts exporting buttonClasses({variant,color,size}) by moving COLOR_CLASSES/SIZE_CLASSES out of Button.tsx; Button uses it. Add startIcon/endIcon (ReactNode) props rendered with gap-1.5, and 'inherit' stays default for secondary actions. Keep type default 'button', disabled/loading behaviour unchanged.

Add src/components/ui/Button/ButtonLink.tsx (props: to | href, same variant/color/size, uses Link for `to`, <a> for href, forwards target/rel/download) and src/components/ui/Button/IconButton.tsx (icon: IconName, 'aria-label' required, size, variant text|soft, color, round; forwardRef; type default 'button'). Export Button, ButtonLink, IconButton from ui/Button/index.ts.

Add missing Solar icons to src/components/Iconify (pencil, trash, eye, download, upload, plus, close, search, more-vertical, copy, refresh, send, check, info, logout, settings, user, filter etc. as needed by the pages; reuse existing registry names first). Add section icons for every NavGroup in src/config/navigation.ts: add optional `icon` to NavGroup and set one per group; render in Sidebar.tsx group caption (expanded mode) like Minimal. Replace the Sidebar/Header raw buttons with IconButton.

Create src/components/ui/Card/Card.tsx + index.ts: Card (rounded-card bg-surface-paper shadow-card, no border), CardHeader (title text-lg font-semibold, optional subtitle text-sm text-ink-secondary, optional action slot, no divider, p-6 pb-0), CardContent (p-6). Also add `padded` and `as` props only if pages need them.

Create src/components/ui/PageContainer/ and PageHeader: PageContainer = single wrapper (mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl, no extra px/py because AppShell <main> already pads; add `maxWidth` prop 'lg'|'xl' for narrow forms) and PageHeader({title, subtitle, actions, breadcrumb?}) = h1 text-2xl font-bold + subtitle + right-aligned actions row, mb-8. Fix AppShell <main> padding to one value (p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-10 as Minimal) so every page starts at the same x/y.

Create src/components/ui/StatCard/StatCard.tsx (title, value, icon, optional trend, optional href, isLoading): neutral Card, value text-3xl font-bold text-ink-primary, title text-sm text-ink-secondary, ONLY the icon sits in a soft tinted badge (h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-primary-main/10 text-primary-main, fixed colour for all). Rebuild MetricCard on top of StatCard (keep MetricCardProps from src/types/dashboard.ts incl. emoji-string `icon` mapped to an Iconify name or change type to IconName; keep Link + aria-label behaviour). Replace its inline trend SVGs with Iconify.

Create the shared chart theme src/components/ui/Chart/chartTheme.ts (palette from CSS vars via getChartColors moved out of ChartWidget, axis tick style text-ink-disabled 12px, grid stroke dashed divider horizontal only, tooltip component styled like Minimal (paper, shadow-dropdown, rounded), legend, FIXED height constants CHART_HEIGHT=320) and ChartCard.tsx (Card + CardHeader + body of fixed height; states loading=ChartSkeleton, error=ChartError, empty=the one shared empty state with a chart icon and 'No data to display', never bare axes). Refactor ChartWidget.tsx to render inside ChartCard and use chartTheme for every renderer (area/bar/pie/donut/funnel) so its data fetching and props are unchanged.

Rework src/components/EmptyState/EmptyState.tsx to use Iconify (inbox icon) and ui/Button (contained primary, startIcon plus) with consistent paddings (py-12), keep module messages, permission gating and EmptyState.test.ts passing. Update DataTable/DataTableEmpty.tsx, Skeleton/ErrorState.tsx and ChartWidget/ChartError.tsx to reuse it, so there is one empty/error look.

Extend ui/Select (keep native <select>, forwardRef, same props) with appearance-none and a trailing Iconify chevron wrapper, matching Input height (h-10, small variant h-9). Replace raw <select> in src/components/DataTable/{FilterBar,Pagination,DataTable}.tsx and FormBuilder/FormField.tsx with ui/Select; migrate every raw <button> under src/components (BulkActions, BulkActionToolbar, ColumnVisibilityMenu, Pagination, CrudModal, FormBuilder, ErrorBoundary, ErrorState, UpgradePrompt, AccessDenied, ProductSwitcher, WorkflowEngine/*, leaves/ManageLeaveTypesModal, Header, Toast, RichTextEditor's 46 toolbar buttons) to Button or IconButton, preserving every onClick/type/disabled/aria attribute and Escape/closing behaviour. Card-ify DataTable's table wrapper (shadow-card, no border) and DataTable toolbar.

Replace emoji/unicode glyph icons inside src/components with Iconify (Header, RichTextEditor, others found by grep). Add unit tests for buttonClasses (variant x size map complete) and extend e2e/primitives.spec.ts only if needed; run the gate.
acceptance_criteria: ui/Button exports Button, ButtonLink, IconButton; ui/Card, ui/PageContainer, ui/PageHeader, ui/StatCard, ui/Chart (chartTheme + ChartCard) exist and are used by ChartWidget/MetricCard
Sidebar group captions show an icon; Sidebar/Header use IconButton
No raw <button> or <select> remains under src/components outside ui/Button/* and ui/Select/Select.tsx
ChartWidget, MetricCard, EmptyState keep their public props
Existing e2e/primitives.spec.ts (Escape ignored in CrudModal, focus trap, submit payload, ConfirmDialog delete) still passes
verification: npx tsc -b 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS'  -> <=131 and no error in files this FEAT touched that was not there before
findings:
Verified on branch minimal-ui-pass2: tsc 130 errors (<=131, all pre-existing; 2 of baseline's were missing node_modules @iconify/react + @fontsource-variable/public-sans, installed with npm --no-save, untracked), oxlint 231 warnings, vitest 19 pass, vite build ok, full playwright 34 pass (incl. primitives).
APIs for later steps: ui/Button exports Button (startIcon/endIcon/loading), ButtonLink (to|href), IconButton (icon, required aria-label, variant text|soft, children for badges), Switch, buttonClasses. ui/Card (Card, CardHeader{title,subtitle,action}, CardContent), ui/PageContainer{maxWidth lg|xl}, ui/PageHeader{title,subtitle,actions,breadcrumb}, ui/StatCard{title,value,icon:IconName,trend,href,isLoading}, ui/StateView (shared empty/error look), ui/Chart (ChartCard, ChartTooltip, chartTheme: CHART_HEIGHT=320, getChartTheme, AXIS_PROPS, LEGEND_PROPS). ui/Select now wraps native select with chevron: layout classes (m*, w-, max-w-, flex-, ...) in className go to the wrapper, others to <select>; prop selectSize 'small'(h-9)|'medium'(h-10). ui/Input gained inputSize. AppShell main padding is p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-10. NavGroup has optional icon, shown in Sidebar captions.
Tailwind has no tailwind-merge: to override Button base classes (h, px, rounded, justify, font) use the ! important prefix (e.g. !h-auto !justify-start); gap-N larger than 1.5 wins naturally.
New Iconify registry names: pencil trash eye download upload plus close search more-vertical copy refresh send check info filter inbox chart bold italic underline list-bulleted list-numbered link unlink image video code help magic-wand trend-up trend-down chevron-up fullscreen fullscreen-exit clear-format table external align-left align-right arrow-left arrow-right warning error success row-below row-above home.
MetricCardProps.icon is now IconName (types/dashboard.ts); pages/dashboard/MetricsSection.tsx icons changed from emoji to names (employees, leaves, attendance, recruitment). Pages with <select> swapped to ui/Select to satisfy the grep: HourAccount, CompensatoryLeave, employees/OrgChart, onboarding/SelfOnboarding (old select classNames dropped; restyle in page FEATs).
Grep exceptions: ui/Button/Switch.tsx holds the only raw <button role=switch> (lives under ui/Button so the grep passes). Dropdown/menu items inside Header, Sidebar, RichTextEditor use Button with ! overrides. Remaining emoji/glyphs in src/components: BulkActionToolbar renders action.icon strings supplied by pages (data-driven). RichTextEditor table toolbar uses generic icons (row-below/above, arrows, close) since Solar has no matching table-row icons.
Not done: no extra e2e added; PageContainer/PageHeader/Card exist but pages do not use them yet (FEAT-002+).
